title: Lakenheath 1956 incident

plain: In 1956, at Lakenheath, a Royal Air Force base in England tied to nuclear weapons, something happened that Michels calls one of the most extraordinary accounts in UFO history. He brings it up in a debate episode with a skeptic and points to a man named James McDonald, who wrote a lot about the case, and to CIA documents and a write-up hosted by Princeton University. If the account holds, it would be one more case of unknown objects showing up near nuclear sites.
